notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome), no Playwright/Chrome needed - conranshop.co.uk redirects to the live storefront theconranshop.com (Shopify), whose theme server-renders the full mega-menu, collection h1/breadcrumb, and Shopify facet HTML (Product Type filter checkboxes with per-value counts) in the initial HTML response. robots.txt (theconranshop.com/robots.txt) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot rule and no blanket Disallow: / - only specific paths (cart, checkout, /search, sort/filter-combo query strings) are disallowed; none of the URLs fetched match a disallowed pattern. TREE METHOD: union of the 'shop' mega-menu (Furniture / Sofas / Lighting / Kitchen & Dining / Textiles (labelled 'rugs, cushions & throws') / Home Accessories / Gifts / Collections / Outlet) read from the homepage HTML, the collections sitemap (theconranshop.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml, ~130 collection handles), and each candidate collection page's own Shopify 'Product Type' facet block (which enumerates every sub-type + exact count within that collection, verified against ProductResultsCount span on the base and filtered URLs). QTY METHOD: exact integer read from the 'N' element rendered on each listing page (base collection URL, or collection URL + a single filter.p.m.custom.product_type= query param for facet-only sub-types with no dedicated collection page) - never estimated. EXCLUDED: /collections/storage-furniture (nav label 'Storage', 46 items) - its own Product Type facet breaks down entirely into Bedside Tables(6), Chest of Drawers(9), Coat Hooks(3), Coat Stands(15), Consoles(6), Sideboards(7); all six are classic furniture case-goods and this collection sits as a sibling of Chairs/Tables/Bedroom Furniture/Desks/Outdoor Furniture directly under the 'Furniture' mega-menu item, so per storage.md Sec21/27 (website explicitly places it inside a Furniture menu -> prefer Furniture) it was classified Furniture, not Storage, despite the 'Storage' label. Kitchen Linen page copy mentions 'Aprons' but the live Product Type facet only lists Napkins(24)/Placemats(1) - no Apron product_type currently populated, so no Apron row was created (would be fabrication). Napkins(24) and Placemats(1) are reachable identically via both /collections/kitchen-linen and /collections/kitchen-dining filters (verified same counts) - kept once under Kitchen Linen (more specific parent). Storage Containers & Jars(17) is reachable identically via both /collections/home-accessories and /collections/kitchen-dining filters (verified same count 17) - kept once under Home Accessories. No dedicated Bedding/Curtains/Blankets/Throws/Storage Boxes/Storage Baskets/Organizer collections or product_type facet values exist anywhere on the site (checked textiles, home-accessories, kitchen-dining, living-room, bedroom, kitchen, outdoor room pages' facets) - Conran Shop is primarily a furniture/lighting/tableware retailer with only a small rugs+cushions textile range and a handful of storage-jar/desk-organizer accessory SKUs. Cushion Covers(64)+Cushion Pads(5) are sold together on one dedicated page /collections/cushion-covers-pads (69) per the site's own hierarchy, not split further since no separate dedicated pages exist for each. No blocks encountered.
